0022600230.text: The Hornets (4-7, 3-7 over their last 10, 1-3 on the road) visit the Phoenix Suns (4-6) in the 12th game of Charlotte's season, with the Hornets 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, and riding a one-game winning streak. Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams, and Kon Knueppel, who are all out with hamstring injuries, and Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out following shoulder surgery. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and Charlotte won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
